records.text: Owens said Bill Ackman deleted the tweet after her team captured it, and that he had reposted someone who acknowledged the lesbian links were fake while authenticating her video, Flickr account, and Farmer’s Hebrew studies.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Bill Ackman has since deleted this tweet, but not before we grabbed it. And he's retweeting another person who actually confirms that the lesbian links are all fake, but says that he did confirm that the video is me through AI voice analysis on the YouTube and that he did confirm that the Flickr account is me or he can and you should read through it. He confirmed that George (George Farmer) studied Hebrew.

records.text: Owens said her Flickr account containing family birthday photos was first archived on August 9, 2015; the year is reproduced as stated, although it is inconsistent with the surrounding 2025 timeline.
